title: Keys can grant scoped account access
summary:
More control over what an app's key can access, a crypto option for Pollen, and a Play login crash fixed.

Key creation and authorization now share controls for allowed models, Pollen budget, expiry, and account permissions. Apps can preselect these options when sending someone through authorization, and permitted keys can access new profile, balance, and usage endpoints.

NOWPayments checkout was added alongside fiat checkout on Enter. Crypto Pollen has its own balance, while the dashboard shows a combined paid balance.

Play now reads the balance API's current response field and checks for a value before formatting it, fixing a crash after login.

highlights.title: Scoped access for app keys
highlights.text: Apps can preselect model access, a Pollen budget, expiry, and account permissions during authorization. Permitted keys can also fetch profile, balance, and usage data through new endpoints. [Connect user wallets](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/connect-user-wallets).
